entries.name: Lidl
entries.note: One Lidl Plus app for all countries (same iOS id and package everywhere). No universal link: the AASA claims only product, category, flyer, search and /prm/ paths, no home path.

entries.name: ALDI Nord
entries.note: ALDI Nord (ALDI Einkauf) app. /app-only/dashboard.html is claimed for the app and names its dashboard.

entries.name: ALDI SÜD
entries.note: ALDI SÜD (ALDI International Services) app; iOS bundle de.bjoerndemming.aldisued. /homescreen opens the app home.

entries.name: EDEKA
entries.note: No universal link: www.edeka.de has no apple-app-site-association on Apple's CDN and no asset links.

entries.name: Netto Marken-Discount
entries.note: No universal link: www.netto-online.de has no AASA on Apple's CDN and no asset links.

entries.name: REWE
entries.note: No home path in the AASA; /shop opens the app's shop section.

entries.name: Kaufland
entries.note: Same app as Kaufland PL. No universal link: the AASA claims only URLs carrying ivy_redirect=true (a redirect marker), no plain home path.

entries.name: PENNY
entries.note: PENNY Germany app; PENNY Austria is a different app. No universal link: the AASA claims /app/*, /angebote/ and /markt, none documented as the app home.

entries.name: dm
entries.note: Mein dm, the same app in DE and AT. No universal link: the AASA claims only /applink/* and /p/d/* (product pages).

entries.name: Rossmann
entries.note: Rossmann Germany app; Rossmann PL is a different app. No universal link: the AASA lists three legacy paths without a leading slash and no asset links.

entries.name: Lidl
entries.note: Same Lidl Plus app as DE. www.lidl.at claims only /prm/* and has no asset links.

entries.name: Hofer
entries.note: Hofer is ALDI SÜD in Austria with its own app (bundle com.aldisued.HoferAT), not the German ALDI SÜD app. Second app: Unser HOFER (iOS bundle at.hofer.unserhofer.at).

entries.name: BILLA
entries.note: billa.at links exactly the BILLA pair. Second app: the jö Bonus Club loyalty app (REWE group AT). Mein BILLA (at.billa.mapp) has no iOS app found and BILLA Scan & Go (iOS 1459386248) no Android one, so neither is listed. No universal link: no AASA on www.billa.at.

entries.name: SPAR
entries.note: SPAR Österreich's own app; SPAR Croatia (hr.spar.app) and Slovenia (si.spar.plus) are separate apps. No universal link: the AASA claims only /app/link/* and /produktwelt/app/*.

entries.name: PENNY
entries.note: PENNY Österreich, a different app from PENNY DE. No universal link: the AASA claims only /unser-penny/app-store/* and /unser-penny/app-direkt/*.

entries.name: dm
entries.note: Same Mein dm app as DE; www.dm.at lists the same appID and package. No home path claimed.

entries.name: MPREIS
entries.note: mpreis.at links exactly this pair. No universal link: no AASA on www.mpreis.at.

entries.name: Migros
entries.note: iOS bundle ch.migros.m-go, Android ch.migros.app. The AASA claims any path with universal_link=true, so the site root with that flag opens the app. It also claims /list/* (shopping lists).

entries.name: Coop
entries.note: Coop Switzerland (Coop Genossenschaft), unrelated to Coop Italia. Second app: Supercard, Coop's loyalty card. passabene is not listed. No universal link chosen: the AASA starts with a bare "#*" component, so whether the root is claimed depends on fragment matching.

entries.name: Lidl
entries.note: Same Lidl Plus app as DE. www.lidl.ch claims only /prm/* and has no asset links.

entries.name: ALDI SUISSE
entries.note: ALDI SÜD group, own Swiss app (bundle com.aldisued.AldiSuisse). /de/, /fr/ and /it/homescreen are all claimed.

entries.name: Denner
entries.note: Denner (Migros group) has its own app. No universal link: the AASA claims only /*/services/app/deeplink*.

entries.name: Lidl
entries.note: Same Lidl Plus app as DE. No home path claimed.

entries.name: Carrefour
entries.note: Carrefour & sa carte Club (Carrefour Groupe). Carrefour PL, IT and ES each have their own app. The AASA claims "/" for this app.

entries.name: E.Leclerc
entries.note: Mon E.Leclerc (Infomil). Second app: Leclerc DRIVE. No universal link: no AASA on www.e.leclerc.

entries.name: Intermarché
entries.note: Les Mousquetaires (STIME). /accueil is the home page and is claimed.

entries.name: Auchan
entries.note: Auchan France app; Auchan PL and Alcampo ES are different apps. The AASA claims "*" after a list of exclusions.

entries.name: ALDI
entries.note: ALDI France belongs to ALDI Nord (seller ALDI Einkauf), not ALDI SÜD.

entries.name: Monoprix
entries.note: M' Monoprix (loyalty). Second app: Monoprix.fr Courses. No universal link: Apple's CDN has no applinks for www.monoprix.fr and no asset links.

entries.name: Super U
entries.note: Courses U (shopping and lists, Coopérative U). Second app: the Mon Magasin U loyalty app, whose domain claims only /redirection/*. coursesu.com claims "/*".

entries.name: Albert Heijn
entries.note: Appie app. No universal link chosen: the AASA claims about 150 section paths (bonus, favorieten, allerhande) but no home path.

entries.name: Jumbo
entries.note: No home path in the AASA; /lijstjes* (lists) is claimed and opens the lists section.

entries.name: Lidl
entries.note: Same Lidl Plus app as DE. No home path claimed.

entries.name: ALDI
entries.note: ALDI Nederland, ALDI Nord group. Second app: ALDI voor jou (ALDI Business Services B.V.).

entries.name: PLUS
entries.note: The AASA claims "/".

entries.name: Dirk
entries.note: Asset links list nl.dirk.app on www.dirk.nl, but its AASA on Apple's CDN declares only an App Clip (appclips), no applinks, so no universal link.

entries.name: Kruidvat
entries.note: No home path; /kruidvatapp is the app's own landing path and is claimed. Which screen it opens is unverified.

entries.name: Lidl
entries.note: Same Lidl Plus app as DE. No home path claimed.

entries.name: Biedronka
entries.note: Jeronimo Martins Polska. No universal link: no AASA on www.biedronka.pl.

entries.name: Żabka
entries.note: Żappka; zabka.pl links pl.zabka.apb2c. Second app: Żabka Jush delivery. No universal link: no AASA on www.zabka.pl.

entries.name: Kaufland
entries.note: Same Kaufland app as DE (www.kaufland.pl serves the same AASA and asset links). No plain home path claimed.

entries.name: Carrefour
entries.note: Mój Carrefour (Carrefour Polska), not the French app. No universal link: no AASA on www.carrefour.pl.

entries.name: Auchan
entries.note: Auchan Polska online shop app. Alternative: "Auchan Retail Shopping" (iOS 1450287430, the same iOS app is "Club Alcampo" in ES; likely Android com.auchan.smi). No universal link: Apple's CDN has no applinks for www.auchan.pl.

entries.name: Dino
entries.note: No Dino Polska app found: iTunes Search PL and Play search return none by Dino, marketdino.pl links no store, and www.marketdino.pl has no AASA or asset links (2026-11-18).

entries.name: Rossmann
entries.note: Rossmann Poland's own app, not the German one. www.rossmann.pl claims "/" and lists the package in asset links.

entries.name: Esselunga
entries.note: esselunga.it links both this app and the second one, Esselunga OnLine. No universal link: no AASA on www.esselunga.it.

entries.name: Conad
entries.note: /app-internal/home_page is claimed and names the app home.

entries.name: Coop
entries.note: Coop Italia, unrelated to Coop Switzerland. Regional cooperatives (Unicoop Firenze) have more apps. No universal link: no AASA on www.e-coop.it.

entries.name: Lidl
entries.note: Same Lidl Plus app as DE. www.lidl.it claims only /prm/* and has no asset links.

entries.name: Carrefour
entries.note: Carrefour Italia (GS SpA), its own app. No home path; /app-carrefour.html is the app landing page and is claimed. Which screen it opens is unverified.

entries.name: Eurospin
entries.note: Eurospin Family. No universal link: the AASA Apple's CDN serves for www.eurospin.it is not valid JSON (trailing comma).

entries.name: ALDI
entries.note: ALDI Italia is ALDI SÜD (bundle com.aldisued.AldiIT), its own app.

entries.name: Mercadona
entries.note: Mercadona has one app, the online shop. tienda.mercadona.es claims "*" minus legal pages.

entries.name: Carrefour
entries.note: Mi Carrefour (Centros Comerciales Carrefour), its own app; iOS bundle es.carrefour.crfmobile. No universal link: the AASA claims only /supermercado/* and a download path.

entries.name: Lidl
entries.note: Same Lidl Plus app as DE. No home path claimed.

entries.name: DIA
entries.note: No universal link: the AASA claims product, category, order and search paths, no home path.

entries.name: Eroski
entries.note: No universal link: no AASA on www.eroski.es.

entries.name: Alcampo
entries.note: Alcampo is Auchan in Spain. Alcampo Supermercado Online; the pair is confirmed by AASA and asset links on www.compraonline.alcampo.es. Alternative: Club Alcampo loyalty (iOS 1450287430, same iOS app as "Auchan Retail Shopping" in PL). No home path claimed.

entries.name: ALDI
entries.note: ALDI Spain belongs to ALDI Nord (seller ALDI Einkauf), not ALDI SÜD. Second app: Con ALDI (ALDI Central de Compras).
